title: 2012 AMC 10A Problem 3
statement: A bug crawls along a number line, starting at \(-2.\) It crawls to \(-6,\) then turns around and crawls to \(5.\) How many units does the bug crawl altogether?

solutions.text:
It crawls a distance of \[ |-2 - (-6)| = |4| = 4 \] when it moves from \(-2\) to \(-6.\) It then travels a distance of \[ |-6 - 5| = |-11| = 11 \] as it moves from \(-6\) to \(5.\)

The total distance is then \[ 4 + 11 = 15. \]

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Add the distance from \(-2\) to \(-6\) and from \(-6\) to \(5\)
Distance on a number line uses absolute differences
